IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result 2025-26: The Ministry of Home Affairs has announced the IB Security Assistant Result (Motor Transport) on 27th January 2026. This is the result for the IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Tier 1 Exam held on 30th November 2026. Candidates who have qualified the exam, will now appear for the Tier 2 Exam. Check the IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result download link, release date, steps to download, and other details here.

IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result 2025-26 Out

The IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result 2025-26 has been announced through the official website @mha.gov.in. The recruitment is ongoing for 455 vacancies, and the candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the Tier I and Tier II exams. Candidates who appeared for the exam can now check their IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Tier I Result and qualifying status for the next stage, from the official website of the ministry.

IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result 2025-26 Download Link

The IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Tier I Result PDF is available on the official website of the Ministry of Home Affairs. The result is available in the form of PDF containing the roll number-wise list of candidates who have been shortlisted for the Tier II exam. Candidates can download the result from the MHA website or using the direct link given below.

IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result 2025 – Direct Link Active

IB SA MT Result Out – Click Here To Download PDF

How to Download IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result 2026?

Candidates can easily download the IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result PDF from the official website of the Ministry of Home Affairs. The steps to download the result have been explained below for your reference.

  1. Go to the Vacancies page of the Ministry of Home Affairs.
  2. Click the IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result download link. The result PDF will appear on your screen.
  3. Find your roll number in the result PDF.
  4. Download and save the result to your device for reference.

Details Mentioned on the IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result PDF 2026?

The IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result PDF contains many important details. Candidates should check all these details very carefully to avoid any discrepancies later. The details mentioned on the result include the following:

  • Name and stage of the exam
  • Exam date
  • Roll numbers of the shortlisted candidates
  • Instructions for the further selection process.

What’s Next After the IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Tier I Result Announcement?

Now that the IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result for the Tier I Exam has been announced, the shortlisted candidates will be called for the Tier II Exam. After the Tier II Exam, the final result and IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Merit List will be released. Candidates shortlisted after the Tier II exam, will be called for the document verification before the final appointment.

Ans. Yes, the IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result for the Tier I Exam 2025-26 has been announced.

Ques. When was the IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Tier I Result announced?

Ans. The IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result for Tier I was announced on 27th January 2026.

Ques. How can I download the IB Security Assistant Motor Transport Result 2025-26?

Ans. You can download the IB SA MT Result PDF from the official website @mha.gov.in.
